messages:
Maya: quick accessibility pass on the top-right action cluster (compact toolbar) from today's usability session. spotted two things: focus ring low contrast + missing aria-label on one icon.
Kai: which icon missing label? and which theme did you test?
Maya: tested light and dark. the tiny key icon (rotate creds) had no aria-label, only a tooltip. focus ring is 1px in compact mode and becomes nearly invisible on patterned headers in dark theme.
Jun: thanks. keyboard users need a clear focus indicator. suggested fixes: increase outline to 3px, use outline-offset so it doesn't overlap the icon, and pick a focus color token that meets 3:1 against both bg tokens.
Kai: agree. also ensure icon glyphs use currentColor so color tokens control hover/active states. i'll sweep tokens and propose a focus-accent token.
Maya: small markup fix: add aria-label to rotate-creds button (e.g., "Rotate credentials") and ensure tooltips are supplementary only.
Jun: note: for focus-visible prefer :focus-visible pseudo so mouse focus doesn't show ring. also add fallback for browsers that don't support it.
Kai: for token testing i'll add a jest check that computes contrast ratios for focus-accent vs header-bg in light/dark.
Maya: can we also expand hit target without changing visual size? 24px icon + 8px padding causes touch hits <44px. let's add invisible padding via ::before to increase clickable area.
Jun: good call. add CSS snippet in PR description.
Kai: I'll open PR with: 1) aria-label addition, 2) focus-visible CSS (3px outline, offset), 3) token change + contrast tests, 4) expanded hit target.
Maya: please include before/after screenshots for both themes and a short note in changelog: "a11y: improved focus visibility and added accessible name to rotate credentials button".
Kai: PR opened #1510, assigning reviewers @Maya and @Jun.
a11y-bot: queued automated checks for #1510; added card "compact toolbar: focus contrast + aria-label" to a11y board with priority medium.
Maya: i'll validate with VoiceOver and NVDA once merged. thanks team :thumbsup:
